title: South Orchard
shortDescription: Low apple boughs shelter a well-used practice clearing.
longDescription:
Apple trees stand in friendly, crooked rows around a patch of springy grass. Fallen blossom collects along the paths, and last year's windfalls have become somebody else's breakfast.
Instructor Flint keeps watch over the Practice Dummy, whose straw hat has survived more lessons than anyone can explain. A Practice Sword, Practice Staff, and Practice Sling wait on the training rack. A practice rules board leans against the basket.

fixtures.name: Instructor Flint
fixtures.lookDescription: A wiry hare with a whistle, a wooden sword, and a hat full of apple blossom. Try talk flint.
fixtures.examineDescription: Flint has one bent ear and an expression of cheerful concentration. Her practice sword is nicked from demonstrations, not duels. She keeps the clearing open and the path to the Infirmary firmly in mind.
fixtures.dialogue: "Which weapon do you want to try? Type take Practice Sword, take Practice Staff, or take Practice Sling. If more than one weapon is in reach, name it in full. Then type attack dummy. Other Collegians are partners, never targets."

ask.text: "Which weapon do you want to try? The sword, the staff, or the sling. Type take Practice Sword, take Practice Staff, or take Practice Sling. A good fit steadies the paw. A poor fit feels unwieldy — we can talk about why."

fit.text: "Each species has one proficiency. Hare and fox like the sword. Badger and mole like the staff. Mouse and squirrel like the sling. A fit adds a little strength. A poor fit takes a little away."

choices.label: I will try a better fit.
I will keep what I have.

practice.text: "Type attack dummy to begin. During the lesson, attack continues. cast ember dummy spends focus. Finish before you walk away. If you fall, you wake in the Infirmary."

misfit.text: "That weapon is a poor fit for your kind. It will feel unwieldy, and your strikes will be a little weaker. Talk with me, or try another from the rack."

switch.text: "Good. Type take Practice Sword, take Practice Staff, or take Practice Sling — the full name. If you type take weapon I will make you choose which one."

keep.text: "As you wish. Feet steady. Eyes open. Pride in your pocket."

fixtures.name: Practice Rules
fixtures.examineDescription: 'Ask before borrowing equipment. Aim only at the Practice Dummy. Stop when someone needs help. A practice defeat sends you to the Infirmary.' Flint has added: 'Winning teaches one thing. Paying attention teaches several.' Try talk flint for the practice commands.
